gaps.explanation: General Fund (Exhibit P p10, 8,586,771) and the nonmajor funds (Exhibit O p9, 582,487) agree exactly with Exhibit E (p4). Street Fund and Debt Service Fund detail comes from Exhibit L (p8), printed on the budgetary basis, while Exhibit E is GAAP: Street budgetary revenue 2,325,208 vs Exhibit E Street Total Revenues 2,174,260 (+150,948); Debt Service budgetary revenue 842,770 + 15,124 + 388,998 + 1,082,441 = 2,329,333 vs Exhibit E 2,370,520 (-41,187). +150,948 - 41,187 = +109,761 = schedule 13,823,799 - statement 13,714,038. No detail fix.

General Fund (Exhibits Q-T pp11-14: 8,206,463 less transfers out 355,632 and capital contributions 512,812 recorded as other financing = 7,338,019) and nonmajor (775,168) agree with Exhibit E (p4). Exhibit L (p8, budgetary basis) prints Street Streets 1,070,596 + Capital Outlay 524,092 = 1,594,688 vs Exhibit E Street 1,600,079 (5,391), and prints the whole Debt Service Fund spending as 'Other Financing Uses' 2,057,754 (recorded as other financing, so 0 expenditure) vs Exhibit E Debt Service Fund Total Expenditures 2,238,128 (Debt Service 124,969 + Lease Payments 11,769 + Bond Payments 2,101,390). 5,391 + 2,238,128 = 2,243,519 = gap. No detail fix.

Exhibit E (p4) Transfers In 608,733 = Debt Service 321,232 + Other Governmental 287,501. Detail has Capital Project Transfers In 287,501 (Exhibit O p9). The Debt Service Fund's detail is Exhibit L (p8, budgetary basis), which prints no transfer line, only 'Other Financing Sources' 233,231 (recorded under that label). 608,733 - 287,501 = 321,232 = gap. No detail fix.

Exhibit E (p4) Transfers Out 608,733 = General 355,631 + Street 253,102. Detail General Fund Transfers Out (Exhibits Q-T pp11-14) = 355,632 (1 rounding vs Exhibit E). Street detail is Exhibit L (p8, budgetary basis), which prints the 253,102 as 'Other Financing Uses' (detail line recorded under that label, not as a transfer). 355,632 + 253,102 = 608,734 (1 rounding). No detail fix.
